item.description: Norwegian airline tells customers not to come to airports after surging fuel costs caused by Iran war ruin finances Norse Atlantic Airways has filed for bankruptcy and cancelled all future flights after surging fuel costs caused by the Iran war ruined its finances. item.title: With new law, Iraq sees rise in child marriage, custody battles
item.description: In January 2025, Iraq's parliament passed an amendment allowing families to place their household under religious law, governing all issues around marriage, divorce and inheritance. The new Ja'fari law, a Shiite law, came into force in October 2025. One year on, its consequences have been raising serious alarm, especially among women, who say they've seen a major rollback of their rights. FRANCE 24's Marie-Charlotte Roupie reports, with Josh Vardey. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Israel: se le agota el tiempo a Eisenkot para formar gobierno, ¿lo conseguirá?
item.description: La formación de Gobierno en Israel entra en una fase decisiva. Sin embargo, la fragmentación del Parlamento sigue dificultando alcanzar una mayoría. Las opciones pasan por buscar el apoyo de los partidos árabes o de las formaciones ultraortodoxas, dos escenarios cargados de desafíos políticos.
